decisions.reason: An accelerator program for green startups sits outside the firm's machinery and recycling knowledge base, so the firm has little related knowledge to interpret its results or apply them commercially, which makes it a likely candidate to be cut as resources go to core recycling technology.

The bio-based bitumen binder is chemistry-heavy and only loosely tied to the firm's mechanical recycling know-how, which limits its ability to assimilate the needed knowledge, but its flagship status and the firm's growth phase argue for keeping it for now.

The infectious waste decontamination plant builds directly on the firm's WASTX waste-treatment engineering and gains complementary knowledge from the ERMAFA cooperation, so the firm can learn from early results and improve the product.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant extends the core decentralized WASTX plastic recycling line, where the firm has more than a decade of related knowledge, so it fits squarely within its absorptive capacity.
